purpose: Four preview-only icon directions; current installed assets unchanged

variants.name: Rune
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a single finished standalone emblem for the desktop app HGS Zerus, an AI agent session manager inspired by Zerus, primordial homeworld of the zerg.
Deliver ONE centered square image with REAL transparent background. This is the emblem alone, NOT an app tile: no rounded-square container, no background plate, no outline frame, no shadow, no glow outside its solid shape. The UI will provide the app tile.
Production requirements: extremely clean smooth antialiased edges, no stray pixels, no speckles, no wispy details. Strong bold silhouette recognizable at 16–24 pixels. Large intentional fully transparent negative spaces between the principal shapes so the silhouette also works as a one-color system tray glyph. At most 3–4 broad components. Emblem fills about 76% of canvas, generous even transparent margin. Straight-on, optically centered. No text, no letters beyond an abstract emblem if specified, no watermarks, no presentation board. Original design.
Direction A — RUNE: ultra-clean geometric organic Z monogram. Two broad opposing chitin chevrons connected by a strong diagonal, cut with two large negative-space notches. Precise compact silhouette like a carved alien rune, sharp ends kept short and substantial. Flat vector-like design with only two or three solid color regions, no texture, no 3D, no thin strokes. Deep vivid violet primary material and a restrained mint-green diagonal face. Sophisticated contemporary developer-tool brand, quietly biological rather than aggressive gaming logo. One strong Z shape, not several floating glyphs.
